S.definition: number of distinct per-provider membership-authority semantic sites actually edited by the phase demand
S.anti_leak: The constitutionally known 5-to-2 topology is not itself an outcome. S is counted only when a phase diff actually adds/removes that phase's provider membership declarations at the named semantic site.

L.definition: additions plus deletions in handwritten product source caused by the phase
L.includes: provider implementation and form churn because those bytes are identical across arms and therefore remain a common lifecycle cost

C.definition: demand-extraneous mandatory runtime capabilities imposed by the treatment contract
C.rule: C=0 only if the base provider contract analysis finds send as the sole mandatory override and each frozen demand requires send only; otherwise HOLD

A.definition: shared architecture integration machinery changed outside per-provider membership declarations
A.dispersed: 0 unless new shared boundary machinery is introduced
A.dual_phase1_expectation: 0 if the installed boundary absorbs later membership without further integration wiring

Q.definition: functional validity under the sealed oracle domain
Q.phase0: 1 only if #7316 IssueTracker replay passes in both arms
Q.phase1: 1 only if all four #7559 SMS provider replays pass in both arms

precommitted_interpretation.cil_support_pattern: DUAL S lower than DISPERSED in phase1; phase0 may show either S birth tax or immediate S saving, but any boundary-installation cost must remain visible in A/L
